snippet.title: Mycelium: The Silent Contract - Co-op Survival Horror | Steam Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Mycelium: The Silent Contract is a dark co-op psychological horror game set in a liminal, procedurally generated forest.

Go alone or with other contractors on time-limited missions. Use your wits and the equipment provided to find your bearings, get Mycelium, complete objectives, and extract alive. But be wary – you are being watched.

🎮 Free demo available NOW on Steam
💀 Part of Steam Next Fest 

🕹️ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3999340/Mycelium_The_Silent_Contract_Demo/
🌐 X: https://x.com/PoKoluStudio
DISCORD: https://discord.gg/m2Ey5SG8FR

Developed by Po Kolu Studio in Unreal Engine 5.
Music by AudioSpaceMusic
